import requests, numpy as np, re, collections, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
def g(u,**kw):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=300,**kw); r.raise_for_status(); return r
def pdbseq(pid,minlen=100):
    for blk in g(f"https://www.rcsb.org/fasta/entry/{pid}").text.split(">")[1:]:
        L=blk.strip().split("\n"); s="".join(L[1:])
        if len(s)>=minlen: return s
def upseq(acc): return "".join(g(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta").text.split("\n")[1:])
three={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def chain_seq(txt,ch):
    seen={}; order=[]
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM  ") and ln[21]==ch and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA":
            r=int(ln[22:26]); rn=ln[17:20].strip()
            if rn in three and r not in seen: seen[r]=three[rn]; order.append(r)
    return "".join(seen[r] for r in order), order

def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    A=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    Ta=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);Tx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);Ty=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); A[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);Tx[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);Ty[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        c1=s1[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(c1,s2[j-1])
            t=(A[i-1,j-1]+s,X[i-1,j-1]+s,Y[i-1,j-1]+s);k=int(np.argmax(t));A[i,j]=t[k];Ta[i,j]=k
            t=(A[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge,Y[i-1,j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(t));X[i,j]=t[k];Tx[i,j]=k
            t=(A[i,j-1]+go,X[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(t));Y[i,j]=t[k];Ty[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([A[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]]));o1=[];o2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0:o1.append(s1[i-1]);o2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=Ta[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1:o1.append(s1[i-1]);o2.append("-");ns=Tx[i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else:o1.append("-");o2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=Ty[i,j];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j>0 and st!=2: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0 and st!=1: st=1
    return "".join(reversed(o1)),"".join(reversed(o2))
def mapper(rs,rn,q):

        if x!="-": ri+=1
        if y!="-": qi+=1
        if x!="-": out[rn[ri-1]]=(qi if y!="-" else None,y)
    return out
